company.name: Anakin
company.shortDescription: Anakin is a pricing platform that generates pricing data and insights for brands to make smart decisions and increase revenues.
company.description: Anakin offers a full suite of competitive intelligence software for retailers and brands. Anakin provides global coverage on real-time product assortments and pricing data from e-commerce websites on over 100 million SKUs. Anakin tracks and categorizes all this data using AI and machine learning.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that continuously monitors competitor pricing and related data in real-time to provide actionable insights for pricing strategy optimization.
